work_item: BODY-1 BB-CONTEXT JSON table comparison explanation consumer and no-resend recovery
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: An actual strict JSON-table comparison -> ordinary same-case ExplainPrevious -> exact sealed-input/report replay -> two-sided source-range explanation -> local-file recovery without resend

implementation.recognition: The consumer recognizes the seven-field JsonTableComparisonReport shape and exact keyed-string-table comparison guarantee, then requires the retained sealed input intent to be JsonTableCompare before selecting this explanation path.
implementation.replay: It loads the actor/case/input/version InputBundle, recomputes ports::json_table_compare from the sealed document/key, and checks the sole prior report dependency, canonical stored report bytes, pretty prior result text, ContentPlan identity/text/guarantee, RenderObservation and both stored content/render artifact bytes.
implementation.explanation: The result reports exact-string equality and change counts; it explains up to eight CELL_CHANGED, ROW_REMOVED or ROW_ADDED records, with JSON Pointers and the applicable left/right decoded values, original byte ranges and per-range SHA-256. The complete typed report remains stored. No semantic-equivalence or factual-truth claim is made.
implementation.core_graph: Core retains the prior result, sealed input-bundle hash and report hash. Existing execution-graph node IDs previous-json-table-transform-input/report were deliberately preserved so pending historical local-file recovery retains its stored identity.
implementation.recovery: The recovery fixture writes the actual rendered explanation, drops the Engine while an effect is pending, reopens the saved state through reconciliation, verifies the same dependencies, confirms the existing target bytes and modification time, and returns CONFIRMED without a second write.
stops: A nonmatching sealed intent is not interpreted as a JSON-table comparison result.
Missing/mismatched sealed input, report, prior text, ContentPlan, RenderObservation, dependency lineage or source-range digest yields a typed stop.
Explanations exceeding the request evidence budget return RESOURCE_LIMIT.

producer_consumer: Ordinary Japanese JSON table comparison -> strict exact-string keyed report with two-sided source spans -> same-case 詳しく説明して -> sealed-input/report/content/render replay -> bounded change explanation and dependency graph -> authorized local-file receipt -> reconciliation confirms without resend.

normal_cli_route.observed: The changed case reports one changed cell, one left-only row and one right-only row. Assertions verify escaped/decoded Japanese values, both JSON Pointers, every reported byte slice and hash, displayed span/hash pairs, equal-table explanation, exact prior/input/report dependency order, execution-graph inputs and actual render hash.

recovery_route.observed: Comparison, filter and inner-join explanations reconcile. The comparison action is confirmed with one saved effect identity, unchanged target bytes and modification time, exact three-item dependencies, and no second write.
recovery_route.process_boundary: The test drops and reopens the Engine state in its recovery fixture, but reconciliation is invoked in the same test process; no separate-process claim is made.
